summary: Iteration 4: Verified Dashboard live MongoDB CRUD wiring. Backend regression: 18/18 test_crud.py pass (serial). Frontend Playwright: dashboard-page renders after login. Stat cards match live counts exactly (TC=3, AP=2 [projects with status!=Completed], OT=2 [tasks not done], CT=1 [tasks done]) — matches seeded data. Recent Clients section shows all 3 seeded clients with formatted $value. Upcoming Tasks shows the 2 open tasks (completed 'Onboarding call' correctly excluded). Projects by Status pie renders with In Progress/Review/Completed slices (pie-empty not present). Stat card navigation: card-0->/clients, card-1->/projects, card-2->/tasks all OK. 'View all' link in Recent Clients navigates to /clients. E2E consistency: Created TEST_DashClient via API+reload -> stat-value-0 incremented 3->4 AND recent-client-<id> visible with '$1,234' formatting. Created open task 'TEST_DashOpenTask' (no project) -> stat-value-2 incremented 2->3 AND upcoming-task-<id> visible with 'No project' label. PUT task done=true -> reload -> stat-value-2 decremented back to 2, stat-value-3 incremented 1->2, upcoming-task-<id> removed from list. All TEST_ data cleaned up. Seeded demo state preserved. Sidebar layout unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx sorts upcoming tasks by `new Date(a.due) - new Date(b.due)` but pushes null-due tasks to the end via `if (!a.due) return 1`. This works but Date('') === Invalid Date leads to NaN subtraction; harmless since null-due are already excluded above, but consider explicit guard for empty-string due values coming from DB.

Dashboard fetches all three collections on mount with no re-fetch trigger when returning from CRUD pages. Users editing a client on /clients and navigating back via history will see stale counts until hard reload. Consider a lightweight refetch on focus or a shared store (already noted as acceptable given current UX).

Command Palette regression check inconclusive — no element with data-testid='cmdk-root' or [cmdk-root] was found after Ctrl+K. Header search input is present so basic UX intact; recommend adding data-testid='cmdk-root' to the palette modal for reliable regression testing.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 client + 1 task via API during E2E; both deleted at end. DB left in original seeded state (3 clients, 3 projects, 3 tasks incl. 1 done).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard is fully wired to /api/clients, /api/projects, /api/tasks with correct testids (dashboard-page, dashboard-loading, stat-card-0..3, stat-value-0..3, recent-client-<id>, recent-clients-empty, upcoming-task-<id>, upcoming-tasks-empty, pie-empty). No re-fetch on route change; use page.reload() when validating CRUD -> dashboard sync. Command Palette does not expose a cmdk-root testid; if regression needed, request main agent to add one.
